paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Reality Fracture is a Magic: The Gathering Arena -exclusive card set in the Alchemy series that will be released on October 13, 2026. It is the last dedicated Alchemy set, before the retirement of the format on February 2, 2027.

Alchemy: Reality Fracture is a digital only release adjacent to the release of Reality Fracture . There are TBA new designed-for-digital cards included in the set () . The set takes place in the Echoverse .
The digital-only mechanics TBA are reused. From the main set, TBA are reused. TBA make cameo appearances.
